title: H Ghost GPU training code
subtitle: PyTorch continued-pretraining and QLoRA scripts for the rented GPU day
description: Versioned copies of gpu/cpt_torch.py (single-GPU continued pretraining of Falcon-H1 on uint16 token streams) and gpu/qlora_unsloth.py (QLoRA library adapter for Qwen3.5-family hybrids) from the h ghost repository, attached to the Kaggle T4 test kernels so the tested code is the code that runs on the rented H100. Code only (Apache-2.0); no weights, corpus text, or credentials.
